query:
MATCH (a:Agreement)-[r:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting)
WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'BWP' AND a.content CONTAINS 'switch'
WITH a,r,m,split(a.content,"\n") AS filterLines,split(coalesce(a.contentWithEquations,a.content),"\n") AS bodyLines
WITH a,r,m,filterLines,bodyLines,[i IN range(0,size(filterLines)-1) WHERE filterLines[i] =~ "R1-[0-9]{7}\\t.*" AND NOT CASE WHEN i+1<size(filterLines) THEN trim(filterLines[i+1]) =~ "\\(Rel-[0-9]+,.*\\bCR[0-9]+.*\\) is agreed\\." AND any(previous IN filterLines[..i] WHERE previous =~ "(?i).*(?:final\\s+CRs?\\s+in|comeback\\s+for\\s+final\\s+CR).*") ELSE false END] AS filterStops,[i IN range(0,size(bodyLines)-1) WHERE bodyLines[i] =~ "R1-[0-9]{7}\\t.*" AND NOT CASE WHEN i+1<size(bodyLines) THEN trim(bodyLines[i+1]) =~ "\\(Rel-[0-9]+,.*\\bCR[0-9]+.*\\) is agreed\\." AND any(previous IN bodyLines[..i] WHERE previous =~ "(?i).*(?:final\\s+CRs?\\s+in|comeback\\s+for\\s+final\\s+CR).*") ELSE false END] AS bodyStops
WITH a,r,m,coalesce(reduce(s=null,line IN filterLines[..coalesce(head(filterStops),size(filterLines))] | CASE WHEN s IS NULL THEN line ELSE s+"\n"+line END),"") AS ownFilter,coalesce(reduce(s=null,line IN bodyLines[..coalesce(head(bodyStops),size(bodyLines))] | CASE WHEN s IS NULL THEN line ELSE s+"\n"+line END),"") AS ownBody
WHERE ownFilter CONTAINS 'BWP' AND ownFilter CONTAINS 'switch'
WITH a,r,m,ownFilter,ownBody ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:CR)
WHERE c.summaryOfChange IS NOT NULL AND c.summaryOfChange<>""
 AND c.reasonForChange CONTAINS (m.meetingNumber+" agreed on a text proposal")
 AND any(fragment IN split(ownFilter,"[")[1..] WHERE fragment CONTAINS "]" AND c.title CONTAINS ("["+trim(head(split(fragment,"]")))+"]"))
WITH a,r,m,ownBody,c ORDER BY c.tdocNumber ASC
WITH a,r,m,ownBody,collect(CASE WHEN c IS NULL THEN null ELSE "Recorded associated CR "+c.tdocNumber+" summary: "+c.summaryOfChange END) AS summaries
RETURN m.meetingNumber,a.resolutionId,ownBody+CASE WHEN a.note IS NULL OR a.note="" THEN "" ELSE "\n"+a.note END+reduce(s="",summary IN summaries | s+"\n"+summary) AS content
ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC
